title: Boursin salmon pasta bake
description: Salmon, sweet roasted tomatoes and garlic-herb Boursin, folded through pasta with spinach, olives and lemon.

steps.title: Prepare the tray
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Add the tomatoes, red onion, garlic and olives to a lasagne dish with olive oil, black pepper and chilli flakes. Put the Boursin in the centre and arrange the salmon around it.

steps.title: Bake and cook the pasta
steps.text: Bake for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, boil the pasta until al dente, reserving some pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Remove the salmon from the dish. Stir the softened tomatoes, onion and Boursin together into a sauce. Add the spinach and some pasta water.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.text: Flake the salmon back into the dish and toss with the pasta. Loosen with more pasta water as needed. Finish with the lemon juice, black pepper and herbs, with the optional extras if using.

title: Mediterranean squash & halloumi
description: Roasted butternut squash, aubergine and halloumi with peppers and bulgur that soaks up the stock in the oven.

ingredients.title: Optional toppings
items: Salmon in a soy and honey marinade

steps.title: Roast the vegetables and halloumi
steps.text: Put the diced butternut squash, aubergine and halloumi in a roasting dish with olive oil, salt, black pepper and chilli flakes. Roast at 180°C for about 45 minutes, until soft.

steps.title: Add the bulgur
steps.text: Add the sliced peppers, 200g bulgur wheat and 400ml vegetable stock. Cover the dish with tinfoil.

steps.title: Finish in the oven
steps.text: Cook for another 15 minutes, until the stock has been absorbed. Add the optional topping if using.

notes: The original recipe does not specify amounts for the squash, aubergine, halloumi or peppers, or a serving count. Those amounts have been left as written.

title: Blackened fish tacos
description: Spiced white fish in warm corn tortillas, with mango, avocado, lime and a spoonful of Greek yoghurt.

ingredients.title: Fish & tortillas
items: 250g white fish, such as cod or haddock

steps.title: Season the fish
steps.text: Mix the smoked paprika, cumin, garlic granules, sugar, optional cayenne, salt and pepper. Coat the fish with the olive oil and spice mix.

steps.title: Make the salsa
steps.text: Mix the mango, avocado, red onion, optional chilli, lime zest and juice, honey and coriander. Season.

steps.title: Blacken the fish
steps.text: Heat a frying pan over a high heat. Cook the fish for 3 minutes on each side, until blackened and cooked through.

steps.title: Fill the tacos
steps.text: Warm the tortillas. Fill with Greek yoghurt, flaked fish and mango salsa. Add lime wedges and feta if using.

title: Creamy mushroom & leek pie
description: Mushrooms and leeks in a whole-milk, cheddar and Dijon sauce, finished with a golden puff-pastry lid.

ingredients.title: For the top
items: Milk or beaten egg, for brushing

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Melt the 60g butter and whisk in the flour. Gradually whisk in the whole milk until smooth and thickened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the crème fraîche, Dijon and cheddar until melted, then season.

steps.title: Soften the shallots and leeks
steps.text: Heat the olive oil and butter. Soften the shallots or onions for about 5 minutes. Add the leeks, cover and cook for 5–7 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the mushrooms
steps.text: Add the mushrooms, rosemary and thyme. Cook uncovered until the liquid has evaporated and the mushrooms are golden, about 8 minutes. Season.

steps.title: Assemble the pie
steps.text: Combine the vegetables and sauce and cool slightly. Fill a glass dish. Top with one layer of pastry, trim and press the edges, cut a vent and brush with milk or beaten egg.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 30–35 minutes, until the pastry is crisp and golden. Serve with chives if using.

title: Peanut-soy prawn pasta salad
description: Prawns, pasta, cucumber and tomatoes in a peanut-soy dressing with honey, ginger and sesame.
timeLabel: Serve chilled or at room temperature

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta, then drain and leave to cool.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.text: Whisk together the dressing ingredients, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Toss the dressing with the pasta, prawns, tomatoes, cucumber, coriander and optional chilli. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

notes: The original chat allows 2 tbsp rice vinegar in place of the white wine vinegar. If using seasoned rice vinegar, reduce the honey slightly.

title: Curried coconut prawn udon
description: Udon and king prawns in a coconut curry broth, with carrots, Tenderstem broccoli and mango chutney.

steps.title: Start the curry
steps.text: Add a heaped teaspoon of the thick coconut cream from the coconut milk to a saucepan. Fry the white parts of the spring onions, garlic & ginger paste, tomato purée and curry powder for 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the broth and vegetables
steps.text: Add the remaining coconut milk, 400ml water, mango chutney and soy sauce. Add the carrots and broccoli and simmer for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Add the prawns and noodles
steps.text: Add the prawns and udon. Cook for 2 minutes, until the prawns are cooked and the noodles are hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with the green parts of the spring onions and coriander.

title: Apricot & pepper rice with sea bass
description: Spiced pepper and apricot rice with crispy sea bass, tahini yoghurt, feta and pomegranate.

ingredients.title: Rice & fish
items: 1 tbsp Middle Eastern or Moroccan spice blend

steps.title: Cook the peppers
steps.text: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan. Add the peppers, onion and apricots and cook for 5–6 minutes, until soft and starting to caramelise.

steps.title: Add the rice
steps.text: Stir in the spice blend for 1 minute. Add the rice, break up any clumps, toss well and season.

steps.title: Prepare the sea bass
steps.text: Pat the sea bass dry and season the skin with salt. Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick pan over a medium-high heat.

steps.title: Crisp the fish
steps.text: Fry skin-side down for 3–4 minutes, pressing gently so it crisps. Flip and cook for 1–2 minutes, until just cooked.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the dressing ingredients with a pinch of salt, adding water until smooth and drizzleable.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the rice topped with sea bass, tahini dressing, feta, pomegranate seeds and parsley.

title: Thai-style watermelon & prawn salad
description: Watermelon, avocado, cucumber and prawns with mint, lime, a little chilli and roasted peanuts.

ingredients.title: For the salad
items: 200g cooked prawns, or protein of choice

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk together the honey, lime zest and juice, fish sauce, sesame oil, garlic granules and chilli paste. Stir in the mint, coriander and spring onions.

steps.title: Toss the salad
steps.text: Mix the avocado, cucumber, watermelon and prawns, then toss with the dressing.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scatter over the peanuts. Serve immediately or chill for 10 minutes.

title: Harissa tuna pitta
description: A warm wholemeal pitta stuffed with harissa-yoghurt tuna and a chopped cucumber, avocado and parsley salad.

ingredients.title: For the pitta
items: 160g can tuna in spring water or brine, drained

steps.title: Quick-pickle the onion
steps.text: Toss the red onion with half the lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Leave for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mix the tuna
steps.text: Mix the tuna with the yoghurt, harissa, salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Make the salad
steps.text: Mix the cucumber, parsley, avocado, onion and remaining lemon juice. Season with salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Fill the pitta
steps.text: Toast the pitta, slice it open and stuff with the tuna and salad. Eat warm and fresh.

title: Cheddar & jalapeño egg burritos
description: Soft scrambled eggs, mature cheddar, jalapeños and greens in wraps to make ahead and tuck away.

steps.title: Whisk the eggs
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Heat the oil or butter in a non-stick pan over a medium heat. Cook the pepper, spring onions, jalapeños and spinach for 2–3 minutes, until softened.

steps.title: Scramble
steps.text: Add the eggs and gently scramble until just set. Remove from the heat and stir through the cheddar and hot sauce.

steps.title: Roll the burritos
steps.text: Spoon into the wraps, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Wrap in foil or baking parchment.

notes: Keep in the fridge for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month. Reheat in the oven, toaster oven or air fryer until piping hot, as noted in the original recipe.

title: Crispy chilli egg smash
description: Jammy eggs mashed with cottage cheese, tomatoes, spring onion and crispy chilli oil, piled onto sourdough.

ingredients.title: For the toast
items: 1 tsp crispy chilli oil, or more

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.text: Boil the eggs for 6–7 minutes, then cool under cold water.

steps.title: Make the smash
steps.text: Peel and roughly mash the eggs with the cottage cheese, spring onion, tomatoes, herbs, chilli oil, salt and black pepper. Keep the mixture slightly chunky.

steps.title: Serve on toast
steps.text: Toast the sourdough and spoon the egg mixture on top.

notes: The original recipe gives 6 minutes of cooking time in its heading and 6–7 minutes for boiling the eggs in the method. Both are preserved.
The original recipe notes up to 3 days in the fridge.
